name: China XLX Fertiliser Ltd.
summary: China XLX Fertiliser Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of urea primarily in Mainland China and internationally. It offers compound fertilizers, methanol, liquid ammonia, Dimethylformamide, melamine, furfuryl alcohol, furaldehyde, humic acid, vehicles urea solutions, and related differentiated products, as well as medical intermediates. The company mines and sells coal; and distributes and sells electricity.
